definitions.gloss: alopecia; hair loss disease; hair loss condition
definitions.explanation: a medical condition in which hair falls out from the scalp or other parts of the body

examples.japanese: ストレスで{脱毛症|だつもうしょう}になった。
{脱毛症|だつもうしょう}の{治療|ちりょう}には{時間|じかん}がかかる。
{円形脱毛症|えんけいだつもうしょう}は{突然|とつぜん}{発症|はっしょう}することがあり、{精神的|せいしんてき}な{負担|ふたん}も{大|おお}きい。
examples.english: Alopecia areata can develop suddenly, and the psychological burden is significant.

notes:
Composed of {脱毛|だつもう} (hair loss; hair removal) + {症|しょう} (disease; condition). The most commonly discussed type is {円形脱毛症|えんけいだつもうしょう} (alopecia areata), which causes round patches of hair loss and is often linked to stress or autoimmune factors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脱毛症|だつもうしょう}になる: to develop alopecia
- {脱毛症|だつもうしょう}の{治療|ちりょう}: treatment for alopecia
- {円形|えんけい}{脱毛症|だつもうしょう}: alopecia areata (circular hair loss)
- {男性型|だんせいがた}{脱毛症|だつもうしょう}: male pattern baldness (androgenetic alopecia)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脱毛|だつもう}: hair loss; hair removal — the base word; can also mean deliberate hair removal (waxing, laser)
- {薄毛|うすげ}: thinning hair — a less clinical, everyday term
- {禿|はげ}: baldness — colloquial and potentially rude when used about a person
